name: @red-cup-engineering/codex-hook-handlers-service
description: The hook handlers the Codex runtime invokes for one machine's Codex customer enterprise: one single-effect script per wired lifecycle event, each a pure operation over a typed AgentLifecycleEvent under the agent-lifecycle-hook adapter. src holds only that algebra; everything that reaches the world lives beside the script faces and reaches it through the registry's effect owners. The machine is named only by its configuration record; no machine literal appears here.

scripts.check: node --check src/enterprise-hook.mjs && node --check scripts/runtime-preflight.mjs && node --check scripts/observe-codex-enterprise-hook.mjs && node --check scripts/check-codex-runtime.mjs
